subject.title: Subagent announce give-up (retry-limit/expiry) does not wake parent waiting on sessions_yield → permanent deadlock

question: Should this issue be resolved by the narrow blocked-completion wake in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95080, by the broader durable announcement queue in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94153, or by adding public retry/expiry configuration now?
rationale: The central bug is source-reproducible and narrow, but the issue also asks for new config surface and related threads propose a larger delivery architecture; automation should not pick that product boundary alone.

options.title: Land narrow wake first
options.body: Review and land the focused blocked-completion requester wake, then track durable queueing and config knobs as separate follow-up decisions.

options.title: Wait for durable queue
options.body: Keep the issue open until a persistent announcement queue replaces direct give-up handling, accepting a longer path to cover more failure modes at once.

options.title: Require config in this fix
options.body: Make retry count, delay, and expiry public configuration as part of this issue, increasing compatibility and docs surface before the deadlock fix can land.

recommendation.title: Land narrow wake first
recommendation.body: Review and land the focused blocked-completion requester wake, then track durable queueing and config knobs as separate follow-up decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent subagent lifecycle and cleanup history makes this the best available routing owner for the product-boundary call.
